Container.Name: LogForge-Unicron
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Docker monitoring and control with real-time logs, metrics, events, alerts, notifications, file access, and guarded remediation.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: docker monitoring logs metrics alerts notifications remediation observability
Container.Requires: Docker socket access is required. The included README describes the one-time Docker network setup needed before enrolling an agent for this Unraid host.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: HTTPS port for the LogForge Unicron browser UI and API.

Config.Name: Agent mTLS
Config.Description: mTLS port used by enrolled Unicron agents.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent authentication, PKI, database, alerting, and appliance state.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Required for Docker inventory, container actions, agent installation, and appliance updates.

Config.Name: Temporary directory
Config.Description: Writable temporary directory inside the read-only appliance container.

Config.Name: Appliance container name
Config.Description: Must match the Docker container name so appliance updates can identify this container.

Config.Name: Central hostname
Config.Description: Hostname included in generated TLS configuration. Change this only when using a stable DNS name for Unicron.

Config.Name: Internal HTTPS port
Config.Description: Internal HTTPS listener. This must remain aligned with the Web UI container port.

Config.Name: Public HTTPS port
Config.Description: Must match the Web UI host port above when that port is changed.

Config.Name: Internal agent mTLS port
Config.Description: Internal agent mTLS listener. This must remain aligned with the Agent mTLS container port.

Config.Name: Public agent mTLS port
Config.Description: Must match the Agent mTLS host port above when that port is changed.

Config.Name: Local agent Central URL
Config.Description: Internal URL used by an agent enrolled for this Unraid host. Complete the README network setup before local enrollment.

Config.Name: Local agent Docker network
Config.Description: Shared Docker network used by the appliance and an agent enrolled for this Unraid host.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Initial local administrator username. After first boot it is stored in appdata.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional initial password. Leave blank to generate a random password in the first-start container logs.

Config.Name: Admin recovery override
Config.Description: Set true only during the documented credential recovery flow, then return it to false.
